audit.why: Early lane is Malzahar-favored (passive shield, perma-shove, Q silence); Veigar takes over after Zhonya's/two items. Content layer already says this; full layer chart contradicted it.
audit.corrected: Full-layer chart aligned to the content chart (Malzahar rows 0-4).

audit.why: Spikes: Malzahar 3-5 shove, 6 Nether Grasp; Veigar Zhonya's/first item then 2+ items. Matches kit and content spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Page never states that Nether Grasp is an interruptible channel that Veigar's Event Horizon cancels — the single most important interaction in the matchup (flagged in missingInteractions).
audit.why: Malzahar R has the channel flag: any CC cancels it. Veigar E stuns.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[1].text and breakdown.cooldowns; real cooldowns (R 140/110/80, Q 6s flat, Veigar E 20s) added.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: When he walks up to refresh E, drop cage on his path — the edge stun buys W its full landing time and he backs off or eats it.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Check it before every step-up. - E Event Horizon (self-cage) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140/110/80s — after he burns it you own the lane for over two minutes. - His Q silence runs a flat 6s; step up to stack right after it fires. - Your E is 20s at rank 1 — save it for his R: the suppress is a channel and your cage's stun cancels it outright.

edits.before: His Nether Grasp (R) is a point-blank suppress that locks you in place and, paired with E and Voidlings, can outright kill an immobile Veigar. You cannot flash it once he presses it, so respect his all-in range hard this level.
edits.after: His Nether Grasp (R) is a 700-range suppress that, with E and Voidlings, kills an immobile Veigar. You cannot Flash once it lands — but it is a channel: a pre-placed Event Horizon edge-stun breaks it mid-suppress, so hold your cage for his commit.

edits.before: Malzahar wins by landing Nether Grasp, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Malzahar wins by shoving you off stacks with Q-E-Voidlings, then suppress-killing you with Nether Grasp when you step past the wave.

edits.before: Q through two units on every last-hit — each stack is permanent AP; the lane is a savings account from level 1.
edits.after: His passive shield blanks your opening Q poke and his shove starts instantly — concede the push, Q-stack from range.

edits.before: W on cage-stunned or rooted targets only — uncaged Dark Matter is a donation to his dodge stats.
edits.after: At 2 his E spreads the wave and Voidlings deepen the shove — you farm under tower while he holds river.

edits.before: Cage online: drop it ON yourself when he engages, behind him when he farms — the geometry does the fighting.
edits.after: Full Q-E-Voidling kit perma-pushes, and the 6s Q silence punishes every step-up — your cage is defensive only here.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-stack on cooldown and double-stack off cannon waves. The curve is the matchup.
edits.after: The shove and his passive shield keep you pinned under tower — Q-stack what you can and protect the curve.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: His Nether Grasp suppress can flat-kill you — never stand inside its 700 range until Zhonya's or his R is down.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: Throwing W at open ground on a moving target, or trading uncaged 'just to stack' — without the wall you are a piggy bank with a hat.

notes: Full-layer chart (all Skill) contradicted the content chart (Malzahar 0-4) — aligned full to content, which the kit supports (passive DR shield, perma-shove, 6s Q silence, R suppress). win[0-4] already read Malzahar so side edited alone per the chart rule. suspectNames flag on 'His Nether Grasp' is a false positive — Nether Grasp is the real R name. tradeGood/tradeBad and 'ahead' remain Veigar-generic templates; grounded partial fixes made via dos/donts, rest recorded in sectionsMissing.
